explication: GG Coder is a desktop coding agent with Code, Chat, Goals, and Motion experiences, backed by reusable AI, agent, and core packages. The main user path is to choose a workspace and provider, submit work, and receive streamed agent activity and results; Autopilot and Goals extend that work into verification and multi-worker tasks. The map includes documented capabilities whose implementations were not sampled. Edges are limited to relationships visible in excerpts, the source index, or the README; dashed edges mark product-level connections not shown in sampled code.
